page.heading: Child Safety Standards
content:
Child Safety Standards

SMK DevLabs is committed to keeping minors safe in our digital environments. These standards define our approach to child protection, reporting, and enforcement.

1. Zero Tolerance for Exploitation

We strictly prohibit any form of child sexual abuse or exploitation, including the creation, sharing, or possession of child sexual abuse material and any grooming or sexual communication involving minors.

2. Age Restrictions

Our services are intended for users who are 18 years of age or older, or the legal age of majority in their jurisdiction. We do not knowingly allow minors to use the Service.

3. Reporting and Safety Measures

Users can report suspicious content or accounts through in-app reporting tools. Reports are reviewed promptly and may lead to removal of content or suspension of accounts.

4. Legal Compliance

We comply with applicable child safety laws and cooperate with law enforcement or child protection authorities when required by law.

5. Contact

If you need to report a child safety concern, please contact us at report@smk-dev.com.
